privacy.pageDescription: Configure built-in AdShield blocker, DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH), Encrypted Client Hello (ECH), and advanced tracking protection.

adshield.title: Built-in Ad & Tracker Shield (AdShield)
adshield.description: Provides native ad, tracker, and privacy protection operating directly within the browser engine without requiring third-party extensions.
adshield.masterEnableDesc: Cleans banners, video pre-roll ads, and intrusive popups at the DOM level across webpages.
adshield.cookieIsolationDesc: Creates a separate cookie jar for each website to prevent ad networks from tracking you across domains.
adshield.queryStrippingDesc: Automatically strips surveillance tokens (fbclid, gclid, utm_*, etc.) from URL links in the address bar.
adshield.fingerprintProtectionDesc: Blocks scripts attempting to profile your unique hardware configuration and installed fonts.
adshield.cryptominingDesc: Blocks unauthorized background scripts that consume your CPU for cryptocurrency mining.

dns.title: Secure DNS (DoH) & Network Acceleration
dns.description: Encrypts your DNS queries to protect them from ISP and network surveillance, bypassing censorship and DNS poisoning.
dns.modeOffDesc: Uses your operating system's default network DNS server.
dns.modeFirstDesc: Uses encrypted DNS over HTTPS first, with seamless fallback to standard DNS if unreachable.
dns.modeExclusiveDesc: Mandates encrypted DNS for all requests; connections fail if the DoH server is unreachable.
dns.customProviderDesc: Enter your custom RFC 8484 compliant DoH resolver endpoint.
dns.echDesc: Encrypts the Server Name Indication (SNI) during TLS handshakes to conceal visited domain names from eavesdroppers and ISPs.
dns.http3Desc: Uses the modern UDP-based HTTP/3 protocol to minimize page load latencies and packet-loss delays.

downloader.pageDescription: Detect and download video, audio, and live streaming media directly from web pages to your local device.
downloader.title: Built-in Media & Video Downloader
downloader.description: Natively detects video, audio, and streaming media from visited web pages. Save media directly to your system without third-party extensions or ad-ridden websites.
downloader.masterEnableDesc: Displays the download button in the address bar and lists detected media items.
downloader.autoScanDesc: Silently scans for media resources in the background when pages load and tabs change.
downloader.badgeCountDesc: Displays a numeric counter badge on the address bar icon when downloadable media is detected.
downloader.typesDesc: Choose which types of media G-Browser should capture. All supported items can be downloaded directly to your native Downloads folder.
downloader.detectVideoDesc: Detects HTML5 video elements and direct video links.
downloader.detectAudio: Audio Files (MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, AAC)
downloader.detectAudioDesc: Detects audio players, podcast files, and direct audio links.
downloader.detectStreamDesc: Captures HLS playlist streams with options to copy stream URLs or save locally.
downloader.privacyNoticeText: G-Browser Media Downloader performs all detection and downloading directly on your device via Gecko's native download service (Downloads.sys.mjs). No URLs or media data are ever sent to remote servers.
